notes: v2.5.38. eBOM status is a workflow with Review, Blocked, Revision Needed and a release builder that sends one email per release; the mBOM status is calculated from real work; CATIA lines and see-through bodies show in the 3D viewer, and lines can be picked one by one; client PO suggestions read the PO number and amount off the PDF for a one-press Confirm; new Tools tab; one loading mark everywhere. This release also updates the database behind AOS, so please update as soon as you are prompted.
